articles.title: Bitcoin miner TeraWulf soars on a $19 billion AI data-center lease with Anthropic
articles.snippet: The onetime pure bitcoin miner signed a 20-year deal to host the AI firm at a Kentucky campus, the latest crypto-adjacent company to trade mining for the steadier money in artificial-intelligence infrastructure.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin confirms AI identified his anonymous Ethereum proposal contribution
articles.snippet: The Ethereum co-founder said AI recognized his intellectual habits, ending a two-week public challenge to identify an anonymous contribution he made.

articles.title: UN agency moves Stellar blockchain payment initiative beyond pilot stage
articles.snippet: The UN Development Programme said blockchain payment pilots in five countries cut costs, improved resilience and will now inform wider use across its humanitarian and development programs.
